entries.message: This update includes restore library loading and navigation behavior, keep dashboard live across browsers and polish mobile Up Next, match opened poster width to the folded poster on phones, polish the setup wizard, dashboard and Jellyfin setup, and fix webhook and Up Next issues, steadier resume sync, faster Up Next return and Emby plugin setup guide, and consolidate the pending Plekt develop updates.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep desktop navigation and library controls visible without empty action space.
Add Movies and TV Shows tabs with Year and Genre filters to cast filmographies.
Center mobile cast profiles and open TV library cards with details beside their posters.
Show loading progress while library pages fetch and preserve distinct titles that share poster artwork.
Keep first-page library cache visible while it refreshes after history changes, and discard stale later pages.
Harden server error responses and update undici to address upstream security advisories.
Recently Watched refreshes on live history events without waiting for provider sync.
Up Next reads the shared server snapshot on every dashboard visit, so the first paint no longer shows a stale browser-local copy.
Clearing progress or removing an item from Up Next updates other devices and open dashboards.
Open dashboard windows in the same browser share one live stream, so queue changes appear in all of them.
Phone featured Up Next cards are taller and wider with larger posters, and their scrollbar stays visible.
The duplicate Up Next title on phones becomes a compact toolbar for queue actions.
Opened posters on Watchlist and Ratings keep the folded poster's width on phones instead of shrinking by about 10px, and opened Watch history cards keep the folded poster's size too.
Discover and Playlists phone rows and the timeline live panel get the related phone layout tweaks in the same stylesheet.
Playing sessions on the dashboard show a "Now playing" corner tab in the top right of the card; paused sessions keep the plain "Paused" label.
Opening Info from a scrolled media page keeps the panel header on screen, and opening it from the Options menu closes that menu.

The Jellyfin setup guide has an Official Plekt Jellyfin Plugin box (recommended) and a Jellyfin Webhooks box, collapsed by default except the plugin box; the repository name and manifest URL copy from their own code blocks.
README, the Jellyfin docs and onboarding lead with the Plekt Jellyfin plugin, with the Webhook plugin as an alternative; onboarding's webhook step uses the same guide.
Media server cards in the setup wizard show the server's logo next to its name.
The setup wizard's backup step groups local encrypted backups and remote backups into collapsible boxes, with Backblaze B2 inside Remote backups.
Setup cards and nested boxes follow the Settings colours in both themes; Plex and metadata setup copy is tidied and import notes are centred.
Up Next no longer re-runs just because a queue push bumped the data version; it re-runs only when the rebuilt queue differs.
Jellyfin webhook user IDs that contain dashes now match the stored IDs, so their watch events are recognised.
Webhook rate limit raised to 300 per minute, so media server bursts are less likely to be rejected.
Returning to the dashboard shows the last Up Next cards straight away and replaces them when the fresh list loads, instead of a blank Loading state.
Add plugin-first Emby setup instructions with local beta availability and the built-in webhook alternative.
Keep numbered installation steps readable on mobile in both themes.
A stopped Emby or Jellyfin session no longer moves a resume point backwards when a newer stop position is already stored
The Up Next push skips a provider whose resume feed already holds the position, which ends the repeating Plex resume loop
Emby items hidden from Continue Watching by older builds come back once Plekt stores a resume position for them
A failed Trakt replace on a translated show now shows a generic message and keeps the error detail in the server log
The website build uses vite 8.3.5, which fixes three launch-editor advisories on Windows

Upload your Netflix Viewing Activity CSV under Settings > Connections > One Time Imports, review TMDB matches or skip titles, and import movies and episodes with their original watch dates after an automatic backup [e6c6b57]
Tautulli and Netflix imports now share one One Time Imports section in Settings [e6c6b57]
Drop or un-drop a show or movie from its detail page or an Up Next card menu; dropped titles leave Up Next while watch history and resume progress stay intact [e6c6b57]
History, Movies and TV Shows gain a Dropped only filter, and Stats shows a separate all-time Dropped count [e6c6b57]
Simkl connects through Plekt's own app with no Client ID, runs checks on demand and after media-server events, and adds a Check now button [e6c6b57]
Bulk watched actions send Simkl writes in batches of up to 100, and Personal Rating Sync now covers Simkl, holding ratings that could change watched history or lists [e6c6b57]
Trakt and Simkl first connections offer a reviewable full-sync preview before any existing watches are imported [e6c6b57]
Opening Settings no longer triggers automatic Seerr capability requests [e6c6b57]
